page.title: LiteGrip Gripper
page.subtitle: Two-finger adaptive parallel gripper · stroke 0–{{max}} mm

connection.mountMismatch: The record declares {{declared}} but the device is running {{actual}} — check the linkage
connection.noSession: This daemon has no gripper session (not Linux, or started with --no-gripper)
connection.connectHint: Connect the gripper (it shares the arm's CAN bus)

source.label: Calibration
source.templateWarning: This is the SDK's nominal template: it declares the mounting direction and nominal 120 mm geometry and has never been measured on this unit — millimetres are a direction check only.
source.factoryWarning: This is the SDK's bundled factory data: if it is not this gripper, every millimetre and force reading is wrong.
source.missingWarning: No usable calibration: motion is refused. Run the zero calibration, or declare the mounting direction on the settings page.

gate.READY_why: The calibration describes this gripper; every command is available.
gate.TEMPLATE_why: Only the direction is declared: open, close and release are allowed, and millimetre targets are refused (the template geometry is a 120 mm unit's). Run the zero calibration to restore them.
gate.FACTORY_why: The SDK's bundled factory data is in use: millimetre readings may be offset until this unit is measured. Allow it on the settings page once you accept the risk.
gate.BLOCKED_why: No usable calibration; motion is refused.

zero.title: Zero calibration (measure)
zero.desc: The gripper drives into each mechanical stop, records the angles and saves the result. Stop is available throughout.
zero.needsEnabled: Calibration needs the drive enabled (so do open and close)
zero.done: Calibration saved: closed {{closed}} rad / open {{open}} rad ({{scale}} mm/rad)

settings.title: Gripper and bus
settings.description: Configure the LiteGrip on this CAN interface: channel, CAN ids, mounting, calibration file and measured travel.
settings.needsDisconnect: Disconnect the gripper before changing the channel or ids
settings.calibrationsDesc: Every calibration this channel could use, in resolution order, with its provenance.
settings.importDesc: Load a JSON calibration from the control machine and pin it to this channel.
settings.allowFactoryDesc: If the factory data is not this unit, every millimetre reading is offset; tick only once you have confirmed it.
settings.travelDesc: Per channel: it is the numerator of every millimetre on screen and has to survive a restart.
